en: Colorized panoramic view of a small alpine village nestled on a green hillside, surrounded by forests and high mountains. At the center stands a church with a tall steeple among clustered houses with red and light-colored roofs. In the foreground is a stone wall and sloping meadow; in the background are rugged peaks. Along the bottom edge there is a handwritten-style caption in Italian.
